name: Kazawallet Card Basic
summary: A secure virtual crypto Visa card designed for everyday online payments and SaaS subscriptions with high daily limits.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only, no physical card

faq.question: Does the Kazawallet Card Basic charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$15.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Kazawallet Card Basic?
faq.answer: It charges about 2% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Kazawallet Card Basic require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
